pick.name: Sentry (official plugin)
pick.why: Vendor-official; match whatever error tracker the ops track picks
pick.free_limits: Plugin free. Sentry Developer plan $0: 1 user, 5k errors, 5M spans, 50 replays, 1 cron monitor, 30-day lookback; Team $26/mo annual ($29 monthly)
pick.install: /plugin install sentry@claude-plugins-official  (or claude plugin marketplace add getsentry/sentry-mcp; claude plugin install sentry-mcp@sentry-mcp); remote URL https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp
pick.license: Sentry and sentry-mcp (getsentry/toolkit): FSL-1.1-Apache-2.0 (each release becomes Apache-2.0 after two years)
